entries.title: Enzyme Active Site Catalysis Chamber
entries.description: A transparent spherical cell contains color-coded enzyme shapes anchored to its inner wall, with small substrate spheres randomly bouncing, docking at active sites, splitting into product spheres that detach and fly off with glowing trails as a reaction-rate meter updates.
